definition: A single payment attempt from a consumer to a merchant, whether it succeeds or fails
The process of transferring captured funds from the acquiring bank to the merchant's account
A forced reversal of a transaction initiated by the cardholder's issuing bank
notes: Distinct from refund — initiated by issuer not merchant

definition: The bank or financial institution that processes card payments on behalf of the merchant
The bank or financial institution that issued the payment card to the consumer
A merchant-initiated return of funds to the consumer for a previously captured transaction
A request to the card network to verify and reserve funds on the cardholder's account
The conversion of an authorization hold into an actual charge against the cardholder's account
The disbursement of settled funds from NovaPay to the merchant's bank account
A business entity that accepts payments through the NovaPay platform
notes: Has a contractual relationship with NovaPay

definition: A financial account within NovaPay that tracks a merchant's balance and transactions
A single debit or credit record in the double-entry billing ledger
A specific instrument used by a consumer to make a payment (e.g. credit card or bank transfer)
The payment network that routes transactions between issuers and acquirers (e.g. Visa or Mastercard)
Adherence to Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards for handling cardholder data
notes: Affects how we store and transmit card data

definition: The technical infrastructure that receives payment requests and routes them to card networks
notes: Synonym for Payment Gateway in internal usage

definition: An HTTP callback notification sent to a merchant's endpoint when a payment event occurs
notes: Must be idempotent on receiver side

definition: A unique client-generated identifier ensuring a payment request is processed exactly once
A group of captured transactions settled together in a single processing cycle
notes: Typically one batch per day per acquirer

definition: A formal challenge to a transaction raised by the cardholder through their issuing bank
A merchant-specific configuration defining processing fees and rates for each transaction type
notes: Varies by merchant tier and volume

definition: The fee paid by the acquiring bank to the issuing bank for each card transaction
notes: Set by card networks; not negotiable

definition: The bank that maintains the merchant's account and receives funds from card network settlement
notes: Synonym for acquirer in most contexts

definition: The bank that issued the consumer's payment card and is liable for cardholder funds
notes: Synonym for issuer in most contexts

definition: The process of replacing sensitive card data with a non-sensitive token for secure storage and transmission
